title: SONGPAL FUTSAL FINAL (Baile Funk × Afro House) [128]
style: Brazilian baile funk meets Afro house, 128 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Portuguese + English + te reo Maori, tamborzao kick-snare pattern, log drums and shakers, talking drum stabs, sharp whistle hooks, marimba melody plucks, deep sub bass with slides, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, stadium-final celebration mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(whistle blow, crowd roar, log drum tap)
(SONG... PAL... FUT... SAL...)
(fi... nal... fi... nal...)
(toa... toa... toa...)

[Build]
(tamborzão pattern locks in, sub bass slides)
SONG — PAL! FUT — SAL!
FI — NAL! FI — NAL!
VAMOS! GO! HAERE!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(whistle roll, marimba climb)

[Drop 1]
(full tamborzão, log drums, talking drum stabs)
FUT — SAL!
FI — NAL!
TO — A!
WIN — IT!
(chop stack +7) vai-vai-go-go / āe-āe-vai-vai
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(half-time pocket, marimba solo, chops trade)
(quem?) (who?) (ko wai?)
(eu!) (me!) (au!)
(vamos!) (let's go!) (haere!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE BALL —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to marimba + sub pulse, crowd hum)
(whispered) songpal... futsal...
(soft) final... final...
(soft) toa... toa...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(whistle roll builds, drums re-enter)

[Drop 2]
(double-time tamborzão, full stack, whistles peak)
SONG — PAL — FUT — SAL! (vai vai vai!)
FI — NAL! (campeão! champion!)
TO — A! (toa! toa!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(crowd roar, whistle, drums fade)
(songpal... futsal... final...)
(vai... vai... toa...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(final whistle long blow, fade)
